gloss: all at once, at one time

definitions.gloss: all at once, at one time
definitions.explanation: Doing or happening simultaneously rather than separately.

definitions.gloss: in one go, at a stretch

examples.japanese: {一度|いちど}に⟦{全部|ぜんぶ}→全部：02888_zenbu⟧⟦{食|た}べないで→食べる：00396_taberu⟧。
{一度|いちど}に⟦{三|さん}{人|にん}→三人：10978_sannin⟧⟦{来|き}た→来る：00254_kuru⟧。
{一度|いちど}に⟦{済|す}ませたい→済ませる：02121_sumaseru⟧。
examples.english: I want to finish it all at once.

examples.japanese: {一度|いちど}に⟦{読|よ}み→読む：00426_yomu⟧⟦{終|お}えた→終える：02019_oeru⟧。
examples.english: I finished reading it in one go.

examples.japanese: {一度|いちど}に⟦たくさん→たくさん：00597_takusan⟧⟦{覚|おぼ}えよう→覚える：00739_oboeru⟧としても⟦{難|むずか}しい→難しい：00517_muzukashii⟧。
examples.english: It's hard to memorize a lot in one go.

examples.japanese: ⟦{階段|かいだん}→階段：00782_kaidan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{一度|いちど}に⟦{二段|にだん}→二段：noentry⟧⟦ずつ→〜ずつ：03092_zutsu⟧⟦{上|あ}がった→上がる：00615_agaru⟧。
examples.english: I went up the stairs two steps at a time.

notes:
{一度|いちど}に means doing things all together rather than separately.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {一度|いちど}に + verb (do all at once)
- {一度|いちど}に{済|す}ます (finish all at once)

SIMILAR EXPRESSIONS:
- {一度|いちど}に: all at once (quantity/number)
- {一気|いっき}に: in one breath, all at once (continuous action)
- まとめて: together, in bulk
